<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def objs(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        key=(min(rs),min(cs))
        d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((key,n['pixels']))
    return d
def orange(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='O':
            b=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b))
    return None
def player(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b))
    return None
print("start O",orange(current_frame),"P",player(current_frame))
seq=['LEFT','RIGHT','DOWN','UP']
for a in seq:
    r=action([a],intent='explore')
    print(a,"-> O",orange(current_frame),"P",player(current_frame),"res",r.get('no_impact'),r.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
